answer: Conductance-cut detection resists sybils: a fake cluster attaches to the honest graph through only a few attestation edges, so it forms a community sealed behind a sparse cut — low conductance. Partition the trust graph and quarantine any region whose boundary is too thin for its internal mass; a sybil dune heaped behind a handful of edges is a bottleneck. Adding clones packs the walnut-dense interior but never widens the cut, so the rising tide of fakes stays walled off.
